scope: Bounded prioritization of new structured collectors; no collector implemented or promoted in this pass. Not an exhaustive sweep of the 243 candidate inputs.

priorities.name: Brazil Câmara institutional events
priorities.evidence: Fresh bounded response contains seven upcoming meetings with official IDs, dated starts, status and room/organ fields.
priorities.admission_gate: Corroborate source timezone; implement bounded pagination, cancellation and genuine-empty handling. Publish institutional events separately from TV replay times. No linear XMLTV mapping is implied.

priorities.name: California Assembly event calendar
priorities.format: official per-event ICS export links with machine-readable date/clock parameters
priorities.evidence: Three advertised upcoming event-calendar links. One fetched ICS has an empty UID and declares VALUE=DATE for date-time values; no source timezone is supplied in that sample.
priorities.admission_gate: Resolve malformed ICS/date types and corroborate source-zone semantics. Treat generated end times as unverified planned boundaries until corroborated. If useful starts cannot be established without guessing, defer. Do not quietly turn this into a presentation scraper.

priorities.name: Harmony public JSON family: Canada House, Canada Senate, Bermuda
priorities.format: first-party JSON route referenced by published Harmony JavaScript
priorities.evidence: Published script requests api/Data/GetUpcomingEvents and consumes ContentEntityDatas with ScheduledStart/ScheduledEnd. Isolated requests using a historical lastModified value returned HTTP 500 at all three sites.
priorities.admission_gate: Reproduce the exact public request/session/parameter contract and obtain real nonempty JSON before implementing. HTTP 500 from the probe does not establish that the publisher API is generally broken. Verify each publisher identity and Toronto/Bermuda timezone independently; never revive the retired HTML parser as fallback.

priorities.name: U.S. Senate committee hearings
priorities.evidence: The official hearings page links to this XML feed; the normal collection client returned HTTP 403 in this pass. The public page currently reports no hearings.
priorities.admission_gate: Establish ordinary collector/hosted access and corroborate a nonempty XML example, including source clocks and stable identity. Keep committee-calendar metadata separate from continuous broadcast ranges. Do not prioritize repetitive header work.

priorities.name: New York Senate session calendar
priorities.evidence: The official events page advertises adding all session dates to a calendar; the normal collection client returned HTTP 403.
priorities.admission_gate: Obtain and inspect the calendar body through supported access. Determine whether it has actual clocks or only sitting dates. Date-only events are useful calendar metadata, not fabricated midnight programmes.

other_findings.name: British Columbia
other_findings.finding: Embedded Drupal/FullCalendar JSON confirmed, with America/Vancouver, 145 entries and IDs. In Session entries sampled are historical multi-day noon-bounded blocks; no current upcoming session example was found. Holidays dominate the non-session remainder.
other_findings.decision: Low priority until genuinely useful current session/meeting granularity is established; do not interpret noon placeholders as broadcasts.

other_findings.name: Scotland
other_findings.finding: The sampled business page had no JSON-LD, microdata, datetime or ICS hints in this bounded inspection. Its TV homepage script refreshes /Home/ContentPartial, a presentation partial rather than a demonstrated structured event feed.
other_findings.decision: Further structured-feed discovery only; absence is not established and no new HTML parser is prioritized.

other_findings.name: Minnesota
other_findings.finding: Combined calendar is reachable; inspected hints point to a calendar-details request. No suitable event JSON/XML/ICS contract was verified.
other_findings.decision: Discovery only; no implementation priority yet.

other_findings.name: European Parliament published meetings JSON
other_findings.finding: Previously verified JSON contains coarse meeting-day boundaries. An existing broadcast collector already supplies event listings.
other_findings.decision: Treat as a possible structured replacement/metadata enrichment, not a new coverage win or automatic source of broadcast starts/ends.

other_findings.name: France JSON agenda ZIP
other_findings.finding: Previously observed 8,547,225-byte archive exceeds the shared fetch cap; meeting-vs-broadcast mapping is unresolved.
other_findings.decision: Defer until a bounded supported route is found.

other_findings.name: Senedd / Northern Ireland
other_findings.finding: Existing observed pages provide useful presentation listings; Northern Ireland JSON-LD describes page/site/breadcrumbs, not the webcast entries. A suitable structured schedule feed has not been verified.
other_findings.decision: Do not reinstate plain HTML collection merely because those pages are easy to read.

ready_vs_provisional: Only Brazil is the next implementation candidate. California and Harmony require bounded contract validation; Senate/New York are parked access holds.

implementation_followup.correction: Harmony 15-digit probe watermark was malformed; corrected 17-digit public requests succeed.
